name: DDoS Security
description: Application-layer IP rate-limiting/blocking to mitigate abusive request floods (not true network DDoS protection).
project_description: DDoS Security (ddos_security) provides an options to improve security of web application. DDoS attacks are typically measured in bits per seconds. This DDoS Security module prevent's that automatically with hits per second calculation. However, these techniques requires server-side implementation. Thus, DDoS Security provides websites with easy and flexible way to implement them.
